name: comp-306
blurb: Dark feature banner with icon, message, dual action buttons, and close.
description: Full-width dark-themed feature banner with eclipse icon, message, Download and Learn more buttons, and dismissible close. Responsive buttons layout.
use_when: You need to launch a feature with clear download and learn actions, dismissible by user.
avoid_when: For single-action announcements; use comp-305 instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons are aria-hidden. Component uses useState to manage visibility.
